source_asset_ruling.purpose: Historical expected.json is a frozen source/expected-roster asset in the earlier run vector. Its old manifest explicitly binds original bytes to copy. This exact version may be recovered from that exact old bound snapshot. It is not a proof/review/message substitution and must not replace the final run expected.json or alter actual expected IDs.
source_asset_ruling.guard: Match exact original path+075cdf digest+98e6 manifest+snapshot path/digest and confirm original is in that manifest own source_files vector; no suffix-based blanket JSON allowance. Keep current 24b3 source value separately observed.

mutable_state_observation_ruling.purpose: The original audit input_hashes records the mutable canonical state bytes read before original acceptance. The unchanged old v1 reader produces such read snapshots; it does not require future canonical state to remain identical forever or recursively treat every nested hash map as a present receipt ref. Original audit bytes remain mandatory and unchanged.
mutable_state_observation_ruling.truth_claim: The existing old Root saved raw copy matches the exact old observed SHA and is already present in the original acceptance Git commit. This transition may add a transparent corroboration ref proving those historical bytes now. The old review did not explicitly bind that copy path, so this is NOT an original-review-authorized snapshot-map edge.
mutable_state_observation_ruling.guard: Handle only this exact immutable parent audit hash, input_hashes field, original canonical path and old SHA. Verify existing copy bytes+Git provenance+original writer code; record the new corroboration classification separately. Do not install generic STATE→snapshot fallback; all current state reads/CAS must still use actual current raw bytes. Do not call the old state current or invent a missing original reference.
mutable_state_observation_ruling.failure_rule: If the actual copy or provenance cannot be verified, report unavailable corroboration; do not synthesize a copy or claim historical state replay PASS. Changed mandatory old receipt/raw/message refs still fail closed.

implementation_constraints: Preserve all original receipts, roots, metadata and copy bytes. Change only already scoped register.py/test_register.py with explicit purpose guards; do not modify frozen formal reader or old evidence.

New archive/graph/plan must expose exact source-map evidence and separately additional historical corroboration ref and provenance. Independent transition review signs this new interpretation explicitly.

The actual current STATE must not remain in a historical drift list requiring prewrite hash after own successful write. Keep historical observation separate from normal current-state CAS; only own known write may change current state guard at postcommit.

Negative controls: wrong parent audit/hash/field/path/version, unbound alternate expected JSON, changed snapshot/copy bytes, fabricated Git provenance, any receipt/message substitution, reuse of old copy as current CAS all refuse.
